_texte.Ai alte întrebări? Echipa My Darrin îți: Any other questions? The My Darrin team will answer.
_texte.Ce se întâmplă dacă clientul nu confirmă: What happens if the customer doesn't confirm?
_texte.Ce tipuri de parteneri acceptați?: What types of partners do you accept?
_texte.Nu. Comisionul din manoperă este 0%: pri: No. The commission on labour is 0%: you receive 100% of the labour price shown in your dashboard. Platform costs (platform commission, marketing and maintenance) are included in the price the customer pays and are never deducted from labour. Registration costs 0 lei and there are no activation fees.
_texte.Cum devin partener pe My Darrin?: How do I become a partner on My Darrin?

_texte.Cum primesc o comandă?: How do I receive an order?
_texte.Cum semnez PV-ul digital?: How do I sign the digital report?
_texte.Când primesc plata pentru o comandă?: When do I get paid for an order?
_texte.Reține platforma un comision din manoper: Does the platform take a commission on labour?
_texte.Da. Ca furnizor de materiale îți listezi: Yes. As a materials supplier you list your products in the My Darrin marketplace. Customers can order them directly or add them to a service. Delivery is handled by the Neighbourhood Couriers.
_texte.Da. Ca operator de închirieri îți listez: Yes. As a rental operator you list your machinery, tools or equipment with a price per day/week/month. Bookings are made through the platform; delivery and collection are coordinated with the customer.
_texte.Da. În profilul tău declari raza de acop: Yes. In your profile you declare your coverage radius — you can select several counties or cities. My Darrin allocates orders according to your availability and coverage area.
_texte.Există o perioadă minimă de închiriere?: Is there a minimum rental period?
_texte.My Darrin alocă automat comanda unui par: My Darrin automatically allocates the order to an available partner in the order's area. You receive an email with the service, date, time slot and locality, and the order appears in your dashboard, under Tasks.
_texte.Parteneri de servicii (prestatori), furn: Service partners (providers), materials suppliers, rental operators, neighbourhood couriers and insurers. An account can hold several roles at the same time.
_texte.Perioada minimă și condițiile de închiri: You set the minimum period and the rental conditions in the equipment profile. My Darrin doesn't impose a standard minimum — you decide your commercial policy.
_texte.Platforma gestionează comunicarea. Prime: The platform manages the communication. You automatically receive any change or adjustment the customer requests through the system. The Neighbourhood Courier is the exception — the customer can contact them directly about delivery details.
_texte.Pot activa în mai multe orașe?: Can I work in several cities?

_texte.Pot vinde materiale pe My Darrin?: Can I sell materials on My Darrin?
_texte.Pot închiria echipamente prin platformă?: Can I rent out equipment through the platform?
_texte.Primesc factură de la My Darrin?: Do I get an invoice from My Darrin?
_texte.Tot ce trebuie să știi pentru a activa,: Everything you need to know to get active, deliver and earn on the My Darrin platform.
_texte.Întrebări frecvente pentru parteneri My: Frequently asked questions for My Darrin partners — registration, orders, payments and discount.
_texte.Suma plătită de client este păstrată ca: The amount paid by the client is held as a guarantee (escrow) and is released after the work is confirmed.
_texte.O reclamație deschisă oprește confirmare: An open complaint stops the automatic confirmation.
_texte.Accesezi „Devino Partener\" din meniu, c: You go to “Become a Partner" in the menu, fill in the form with your company or sole-trader details, upload the requested documents (tax ID, authorisations, insurance) and send the application. The My Darrin team checks your file and approves the account. You receive orders after approval, with the contract signed and the bank account added.
_texte.CUI/CIF, certificat de înregistrare, aut: Tax ID, registration certificate, relevant professional authorisations (e.g. an ANRE certificate for electricians and for natural gas installers), motor liability insurance if you use a vehicle, professional liability insurance. The exact documents differ by service category.
_texte.Nu. Contul este verificat de echipa My D: No. Your account is checked by the My Darrin team at approval. You receive orders after approval, with the contract signed and the bank account added.
_texte.Da, o poți declina din dashboard. Dacă e: Yes, you can decline it from the dashboard. If you are unavailable, you pause your account from the dashboard and receive no orders during that period.
_texte.La sosire fotografiezi zona de lucru, ia: On arrival you photograph the work area, and at the end you photograph it again. The images are the basis for confirming the work and for any complaint.
_texte.La finalul lucrării, din dashboard, marc: At the end of the work, from the dashboard, you mark the work as finished, with the before and after photos. The client receives the confirmation link by email.
_texte.Tu emiți factura către Home Best Pal SRL: You issue the invoice to Home Best Pal SRL, the general contractor, for confirmed work. You will find your invoices in the partner dashboard.
_texte.La ridicarea echipamentului și la return: Mandatory condition photos are taken when the equipment is collected and when it is returned. Any damage is documented with photos and handled through a complaint.
